verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at help.angelliststack.com that indexes the help center as Markdown pages, and the help articles themselves are served as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs. The evidence is a single probe covering only the Stack help center, with no first-party documentation describing agent-oriented usage. missing for 10: llms.txt coverage beyond the Stack help center (e.g., main angellist.com products), first-party documentation of agent-oriented docs or llms-full.txt, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://help.angelliststack.com/llms.txt # AngelList
